text: Hey, thanks for making time. How was the week?
Pretty good. The search rewrite landed on Tuesday, and latency dropped by about forty percent.
That's a big win. Any problems since the release?
One customer reported missing results for old documents, so I'm backfilling the index tonight.
Okay. Let's make sure support knows.
Perfect. I also wanted to talk about next quarter. Would you like to lead the mobile sync project?
I'd love that, but I'd need someone to pick up on-call for the first month.
Fair. I'll ask Priya and come back to you by Friday.
One more thing: the design review moved to Thursday at two.
Got it. I'll update the invite. Thanks.
